text:
maria (Finance): Heads up — Vendor Atlas Analytics submitted invoice PO3321 for $12,500 but attached a CA resale certificate and an unsigned W-9 scan. AP is blocking payment until we have a valid W-9. Also the invoice applied our pricing-experiment credits on the same line so tax amount looks off. They list a foreign mailing address on the header despite saying they are a US LLC. What do we need to accept here?
andrew (Accounting): We need a signed W-9 with EIN or last4 SSN. CA resale cert only covers tangible goods sold for resale, not services — so likely not applicable if this is analytics/SaaS. Ask them to reissue invoice, itemize credits, and provide a proper W-9.
leo (Vendor Ops): I can ping Atlas with our template. Quick Q — does AP accept e-signed W-9s or do they want wet signature?
paige (Tax Counsel): Short answer: e-signed W-9s are fine if the e-sign process meets our vendor onboarding policy, but AP needs to capture it in Coupa/NetSuite per recordkeeping. Also: if they're actually a foreign entity, they'd need a W-8 form, and we may have to withhold (30% backup withholding) unless treaty applies. If they claim US LLC but provide foreign address, we need clarification — country of organization vs mailing address matters.
invoice-bot: Invoice PO3321 flagged — invoice total differs from PO by >10% and will require GL approver signoff before payment.
andrew (Accounting): On the pricing-credit: state sales tax treatment varies, but typically credits reduce taxable amount. We prefer credits be a separate line item with negative amount so AP/tax can properly treat it. For now, hold payment until corrected docs arrive.
maria (Finance): Noted. I'll ask vendor to: 1) send a corrected invoice with credits as separate line items, 2) provide a signed W-9 (e-sign ok per policy), 3) confirm legal entity and US tax classification, and 4) reattach bank details for ACH.
leo (Vendor Ops): Sending email now using vendor-docs template. CCing AP and Tax. I'll paste the email body here for records: "Hi Atlas — thx for the invoice. Can you please reissue with a signed W-9 (or W-8 if foreign), separate credit line(s), and confirm entity/address? We cannot process payment until we receive these. Please respond within 3 business days to avoid delayed remittance"
AtlasAP (Vendor): Thanks for the heads up — sending updated PDF with e-signature now and corrected domestic address. The resale cert was attached in error; we provide analytics SaaS, not resale goods. Reissued invoice will separate the promo credit line. Sorry for the confusion.
paige (Tax Counsel): If they send the corrected W-9 and confirm US person status, no withholding or gross-up needed. If they end up being foreign and submit W-8, we need to evaluate withholding. Also confirm whether any of the credit lines are reimbursements vs discounts — reimbursements can have different tax treatment.
maria (Finance): Great — once we get the new W-9 and corrected invoice I'll route for GL approval. Marking as pending docs. :white_check_mark: 
leo (Vendor Ops): Got it. Vendor says PDF emailed. I'll upload to Coupa and tag AP. :thumbsup:
andrew (Accounting): After we process, update the vendor master file with EIN and address. If any backup withholding was needed, we will handle remittance.
maria (Finance): Thanks everyone — resolving once AP confirms payment scheduled.
